jobs.title: Senior Director, AI Research- FR
jobs.description:
Description Du Poste

What is the opportunity?

RBC's AI Group is building the future of AI-powered banking, and our research teams are at the forefront of this transformation. Reporting to the VP, Applied AI Research & Solutions, the Senior Director, AI Research will lead a team of world-class machine learning researchers and research engineers to develop cutting-edge AI algorithms that directly power RBC's products and services.

This is a unique opportunity to bridge frontier AI research with real-world business impact. You'll work at the intersection of innovation and application by translating the latest advances in machine learning into production-ready solutions that serve millions of clients across credit, fraud detection, market intelligence, pricing optimization, and generative AI applications.

As a member of RBC Borealis AI, you'll leverage RBC's unique data assets and strategic partnerships to push the boundaries of what's possible in AI, while ensuring your work delivers measurable business value aligned with RBC's $1 billion AI ambition.

What will you do?

AI Research Leadership:

Lead and mentor a high-performing team of AI researchers and research engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and impact-driven solutions.
Direct the development of novel machine learning algorithms and models across one or more domains: credit risk, fraud detection, market prediction, pricing & optimization, or generative/agentic AI. Leverage RBC and external data to deliver differentiating solutions and intellectual property to the business.
Define AI roadmaps with ML models that balance advancing the state-of-the-art with delivering tangible business outcomes aligned to RBC's strategic priorities.
Build and retain top-tier AI talent by creating an environment that attracts leading researchers from both academia and industry.
Act as a thought leader and partner to RBC businesses and functions and advise on the art of the possible for AI in these domains.
Evaluate new areas for AI investment, complete proof of concept testing and evaluation.

Applied Research & Business Impact:

Partner closely with the VP, AI Research and Innovation team to operationalize frontier research and translate breakthroughs into applied solutions.
Collaborate with VP, Solutions Engineering & Delivery to ensure AI algorithms are production-ready, scalable, and integrated seamlessly into RBC's enterprise platforms.
Drive rapid experimentation and iteration to test and validate models against real-world business problems, ensuring measurable ROI.
Develop intellectual property and publish research findings that position RBC as a thought leader in AI innovation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

Act as a trusted technical advisor to business partners across RBC's lines of business, translating complex AI concepts into actionable insights.
Work with platform teams to leverage RBC's AI & data infrastructure (Lumina) for model development, training, and deployment.
Partner with AI Governance & Evaluation teams to ensure all models meet regulatory, ethical, and compliance standards.
Engage with external research communities, academic institutions, and industry partners to stay ahead of emerging AI trends and technologies.
Champion responsible AI practices, embedding fairness, transparency, and bias mitigation into the research lifecycle.
Identify opportunities to advance RBC's AI capabilities through experimentation with emerging technologies (e.g., foundation models, multimodal AI, reinforcement learning).
Contribute to RBC's AI thought leadership through publications, patents, conference presentations, and community engagement.
In this role, you will communicate and interact frequently with RBC partners and/or employees located across Canada and/or worldwide.

What do you need to succeed?

Must Have:

PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.
10+ years of experience developing and deploying machine learning models in industry settings, with at least 3-5 years in leadership roles and people management.
Experience translating research prototypes into production-grade solutions at scale, preferably in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, etc.).
Strong publication record and recognized thought leadership in AI/ML (conference papers, patents, technical blogs, or open-source contributions).
Demonstrated ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical stakeholders, communicating complex concepts clearly to senior leadership.

What's in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

Work at the cutting edge of AI: Access to RBC's unique data assets, world-class compute infrastructure, and strategic partnerships with leading AI research institutions.
Industry-leading research environment: Publish your work, attend top-tier conferences, and collaborate with renowned researchers from RBC Borealis and beyond.
Real-world impact: Your research will directly power products and services used by millions of clients across Canada and globally.
Comprehensive Total Rewards Program including competitive compensation, bonuses, flexible benefits, and stock options.
Talent development: Leaders who support your growth through coaching, mentorship, and opportunities to shape RBC's AI strategy.
Dynamic, high-performing team: Work alongside some of the brightest minds in AI, machine learning, and financial services.
Opportunities for progressively greater impact: Shape the future of AI at one of the world's leading financial institutions.

Notre milieu de travail propice à l’excellence, à la collaboration, à l’innovation et à l’épanouissement professionnel de nos employés contribue à concrétiser notre raison d’être et à générer de la valeur pour nos clients et les collectivités où nous exerçons nos activités. Pour cela, nous mettons en place des politiques et des programmes visant à favoriser un milieu de travail fondé sur le respect et l’appartenance et offrant des occasions pour tous.

jobs.title: Director of Infrastructure Solution Architecture
jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 265950

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

Leads and oversees Infrastructure Solution Architecture in Global Technology & Enterprise Platforms (GTEP) globally ensuring business strategies, plans and initiatives are executed / delivered in compliance with governing regulations, internal policies and procedures.

Leads the Infrastructure Solution Architecture team responsible for delivering end-to-end infrastructure solution architecture for programs, projects, products, and initiatives for GTEP services. The role ensures solution designs consistently leverage approved architecture patterns, standards, and certified Engineering service offerings while aligning with enterprise architecture principles, regulatory obligations, resilience expectations, and the Bank’s risk appetite.

This role is accountable for enabling consistent, scalable, secure, and service-based infrastructure solution delivery across Network, Unified Communications, Enterprise Platforms, Cloud, Data Center, Hosting, Compute, Virtualization, Server OS, Containerization, Database, Storage, and related infrastructure platforms. The role provides the delivery-facing architecture function that translates strategy, standards, and Engineering service offerings into practical solution designs for implementation.

Is this role right for you? In this role, you will:

Leads and oversees the Infrastructure Solution Architecture team, providing direction, prioritization, and accountability for Infrastructure solution delivery across enterprise demand
Builds and develops a high-performing team through coaching, mentorship, and succession planning
Establishes clear expectations for solution architecture quality, consistency, and alignment to standards and Engineering services
Drives a customer-focused, delivery-oriented culture supporting enterprise consumption of GTEP services
Leads end-to-end infrastructure solution architecture for enterprise programs, projects, products, and initiatives consuming GTEP services
Ensures solution designs are scalable, secure, resilient, cost-effective, and aligned to business and regulatory requirements
Provides architectural oversight from intake through design, approval, and delivery alignment
Ensures consistent integration across infrastructure domains (network, cloud, platforms, compute, storage, and related services)
Ensures all solution designs consume certified Engineering service offerings and approved architecture patterns wherever possible
Partners with Engineering to validate service availability, feasibility, and operational readiness
Promotes repeatable and standardized solution delivery through reuse of approved services and patterns
Ensures deviations are identified early and governed through the ARB exception process
Aligns solution designs to target-state architectures, standards, and platform strategies defined by Infrastructure Strategy & Architecture
Partners with Governance & Assurance to ensure compliance with ARB requirements, standards, and control frameworks
Ensures risks, trade-offs, and non-standard decisions are clearly documented and governed
Provides feedback to Strategy & Architecture on gaps in standards, patterns, or Engineering services
Works across Client Engagement, Engineering, Strategy & Architecture, Governance, Security, and Risk teams to deliver aligned and executable solutions
Acts as escalation point for cross-domain design conflicts, dependencies, and delivery constraints
Ensures solution architecture supports operational controls, regulatory compliance, and enterprise risk posture
Drives consistent solution outcomes and eliminates one-off or non-standard designs across the enterprise
Understand how the Bank’s risk appetite and risk culture should be considered in day-to-day activities and decisions.
Creates an environment in which their team pursues effective and efficient operations of their respective areas in accordance with Scotiabank’s Values, its Code of Conduct and the Global Sales Principles, while ensuring the adequacy, adherence to and effectiveness of day-to-day business controls to meet obligations with respect to operational, compliance, AML/ATF/sanctions and conduct risk.
Builds a high performance environment and implements a people strategy that attracts, retains, develops and motivates their team by fostering an inclusive work environment and using a coaching mindset and behaviours; communicating vison/values/business strategy; and, managing succession and development planning for the team.
Understand how the Bank’s risk appetite and risk culture should be considered in day-to-day activities and decisions.

Skills

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We'd love to work with you if you have:

Leads the Infrastructure Strategy & Architecture function across multiple global infrastructure domains, including Network, Unified Communications, Enterprise Platforms, Data Center, Hosting, Compute, Virtualization, Server OS, Containerization, Database, and Storage technologies.
Provides leadership to a team of senior architecture resources responsible for target-state architecture, standards, patterns, roadmaps, and platform strategy.
Influences high-complexity, enterprise-wide infrastructure architecture decisions across global, matrixed technology teams.
Supports architecture alignment across regulatory, security, resilience, risk, and enterprise governance expectations in a financial services environment.
Provides strategic architecture input to major infrastructure transformation initiatives, platform modernization efforts, standards lifecycle decisions, and technology rationalization activities.
Exercises strategic influence and architectural decision‑making authority with VPs, Heads, Director’s stakeholders within and outside of Technology.

What's in it for you?

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Allyship - We strive to create an inclusive culture where every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are, and are embraced through bias-free practices and inclusive values across Scotiabank. We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employee to learn, grow & participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability & veterans.
Accessibility and Workplace Accommodations - We value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Scotiabank continues to locate, remove and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements.
Upskilling through online courses, cross-functional development opportunities, and tuition assistance.
Competitive Rewards program including bonus, flexible vacation, personal, sick days and benefits will start on day one.
Community Engagement - no matter where you choose to work from; we offer opportunities for community engagement & belonging with our various programs such as hackathons, contests, cooking with friends, Humans of Digital and much more!

Location(s): Canada : Ontario : Toronto

Scotiabank is a leading bank in the Americas. Guided by our purpose: "for every future", we help our customers, their families and their communities achieve success through a broad range of advice, products and services, including personal and commercial banking, wealth management and private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets.

At Scotiabank, we value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. If you require accommodation (including, but not limited to, an accessible interview site, alternate format documents, ASL Interpreter, or Assistive Technology) during the recruitment and selection process, please let our Recruitment team know. If you require technical assistance, please click here. Candidates must apply directly online to be considered for this role. We thank all applicants for their interest in a career at Scotiabank; however, only those candidates who are selected for an interview will be contacted.

jobs.title: Vice President Finance
jobs.description:
Our client is a diversified privately-held company that has been in business for over 25 years. They have over 500 employees and are growing across North America and have the immediate need for a Vice President, Finance. This is an on-site
role located in Brampton, ON.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the CFO, our client has the immediate need to recruit a VP Finance who will play an important role in leading and managing the financial operations and reporting of the company. You will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of financial management, providing strategic financial guidance, and contributing to the overall success and growth of the organization. Your expertise in financial analysis, forecasting, and decision-making will be crucial in driving the company’s financial performance and ensuring its long-term financial stability.

Specific responsibilities include, but are not limited, to the following:

·Lead the financial reporting process and maintain effective controls over the responsibility, accuracy, and completeness of the results through a detailed understanding and ownership of the accounting processes and core operational systems. 
·Lead the budgeting, forecasting, and financial modelling processes to ensure accurate and comprehensive financial projections.
·Conduct regular analysis of financial performance, identifying trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement. 
·Oversee day-to-day financial operations, including accounting, treasury, taxation, and financial systems.
·Manage cash flow, working capital, and capital allocation to optimize financial resources.
·Implement internal controls and best practices to safeguard company assets and maintain financial integrity.
·Provide financial insights and analysis to support key business decisions, such as investments, mergers and acquisitions, and expansion initiatives.
·Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing finance and accounting team, fostering a collaborative and results-driven culture.
·Collaborate with external stakeholders, including auditors, tax advisors, and financial institutions.
·Identify accounting simplification where appropriate. 
·Manage the annual external audit process. 

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

·Approximately 12+ years of demonstrated technical financial acumen in accounting and reporting. Preferably have trained as a CPA with one of the public accounting firms. 
·A minimum of 3-5 years at the Director/VP level having managed a team. 
·Current or previous experience working in a public-company reporting environment either leading or having responsibility for multiple facets of the finance function.
·Strong technical accountant with a preference for someone with IFRS reporting experience.     
·An understanding of tax planning and tax structuring. 

PERSONAL CHARACTERISTICS

·Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
·Hands-on; will “roll up sleeves” to do the work. 
·Highly analytical and intellectually curious. Able to “connect the dots” and communicate financial data in a meaningful way. 
·High level of integrity, confidentiality, and accountability.
·A positive and “can do” attitude and gets things done; demonstrates initiative.   

EDUCATION

·University Degree.
·CPA designation

COMPENSATION

Our client is targeting a base salary of approximately $150,000 to $200,000 plus annual bonus, and benefits. There is no RSP or LTI. There is some flexibility on the base salary for the right candidate.

We thank all applicants but only those selected for an interview will be contacted.
